articles.excerpt: India's contract drug manufacturing sector is booming as global pharma outsources more production, but the three leading listed CDMOs are betting on very different strategies to capture that growth.
articles.nri_angle: India's CDMO sector expansion is driven in part by global pharmaceutical companies seeking cost-effective manufacturing partners, creating investment opportunities in a sector with strong structural growth.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sandisk Stock Surges Past S&P 500 as Analysts Back AI-Driven Growth
articles.excerpt: The data storage company has emerged as a top-performing value stock, outpacing the broader market as Wall Street analysts rally behind its aggressive push into AI infrastructure.
articles.nri_angle: Sandisk's AI-driven stock surge is relevant for tech-sector investors tracking the broadening AI trade.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: US Oil Refiners Post Record Profits as Iran War Drives Margins to All-Time Highs
articles.excerpt: Marathon Petroleum, Valero, and Phillips 66 earned a combined $12.6 billion in Q2 and returned $6.3 billion to shareholders, the most in over two years.
articles.nri_angle: Record refining margins impact US consumer energy costs and global oil market dynamics
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bayern Munich Sells Final 5% Stake to Viessmann Family for €250 Million
articles.excerpt: The deal brings Max Viessmann's investment group into the ownership structure of one of football's most valuable clubs, valuing Bayern Munich AG at €5 billion.
articles.nri_angle: Major global sports investment deal highlighting the growing financialization of European football
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Zetwerk Files Updated IPO Papers as FY26 Revenue Hits Rs 15,900 Crore
articles.excerpt: The contract manufacturing unicorn filed its updated DRHP with SEBI, aiming to raise Rs 2,600 crore in fresh capital while reporting a 24% revenue jump in FY26.
articles.nri_angle: Zetwerk's global operations across the US, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East, along with its marquee international client base, make it a closely watched IPO for NRI investors tracking India's manufacturing sector.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Pulls Off Largest-Ever Stake Sale With Rs 31,552 Crore LIC OFS
articles.excerpt: The government raised more than double its original target by selling a 6.5% stake in LIC through a tightly guarded Offer for Sale, pushing public shareholding to 10% ahead of the regulatory deadline.
articles.nri_angle: LIC remains one of the most widely held financial products among the Indian diaspora, and the increased public float could improve liquidity for NRI investors holding or looking to trade LIC shares.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Is Rs 5 Crore Enough to Retire in India or Do You Need Rs 10 Crore
articles.excerpt: Retirement planning in India increasingly revolves around viral corpus targets, but financial experts say the right number depends on lifestyle, location, and inflation — not social media benchmarks.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs planning to return to India or retire there face similar corpus planning challenges, with metro vs tier-2 city choices significantly affecting required savings.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Broadcom's Custom AI Chip Business Is Bigger Than the Market Thinks
articles.excerpt: With AI semiconductor revenue on track to hit $56 billion in fiscal 2026 and bookings outpacing shipments 3-to-1, Broadcom's XPU platform is cementing its position as the backbone of hyperscaler custom silicon.
articles.image_caption: Broadcom's headquarters in San Jose, California. The company's custom AI chip business has grown from $3 billion to over $10 billion in quarterly revenue in roughly two quarters.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jane Street Suffers Record $15 Billion Loss From AI Selloff and Hedge Fund Blowup
articles.excerpt: The Wall Street trading giant's worst monthly loss ever was driven by the collapse of AI-focused hedge fund Situational Awareness and a broader tech stock rout, though the firm still boasts $40 billion in year-to-date revenue.
articles.image_caption: Jane Street Capital is a quantitative trading firm and market maker headquartered in New York City. The firm has become one of the most influential players in global financial markets.
articles.nri_angle: The AI selloff that hit Jane Street also affected major tech stocks held by retail and institutional investors globally, including significant Indian-American participation in AI-sector investments.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tata Group Shares Slide as Chandrasekaran Exit Wipes Billions Off India's Largest Conglomerate
articles.excerpt: TCS drops nearly 4% and drags benchmark indexes lower as the chairman's resignation raises fresh questions about succession and governance at the 158-year-old group.
articles.nri_angle: Tata Group's 26 listed companies carry a combined market cap of $277 billion, and TCS alone is a major employer of Indian-origin IT professionals globally; the selloff signals investor anxiety over the group's direction.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
